title: Primary Logo QR Code
slide_intent: Preserve the function of a branded code because a recognizable graphic is useful only if people can scan it.
strategic_value: The custom burger-shaped code can carry Burger King personality into a digital access point.
demonstration: A brown QR-code logo is paired with a circle-based clearance diagram and a smaller minimum-size specimen.
practical_value: Keep one QR circle diameter clear around the code and respect the stated print and digital minimum recommendations.

content_islands.name: QR purpose and rules
content_islands.spec: Use the left column for the rationale, clearance rule and minimum-size rule.

content_islands.name: Code and clearspace
content_islands.spec: Stack the large code above its shaded clearance diagram in the center, using the code’s circle as the measuring unit.

content_islands.name: Minimum-size specimen
content_islands.spec: Place a small code at right with 1 inch print width and 96 pixels digital width captions.

reference_purposes.Intent: The source says the design combines brand personality with functionality and minimum size is essential to scanning.
reference_purposes.Expression: The code forms a Burger King silhouette and lettering in brown.
reference_purposes.Application: The circle diameter defines clearspace; the recommended minimum is 1 inch wide in print and 96 pixels on screen.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The specified clearance separates the outer code edge from other visual and verbal elements.

ingredient.name: Branded QR code
ingredient.role: Provide a recognizable route to the brand’s digital presence.
ingredient.application: Reserve one code-circle diameter around the outer edge; use at least the recommended 1-inch print width or 96-pixel screen width.
ingredient.scope: Historical partner guide. The page states recommended minimum size; it does not establish verified scanning performance for every surface.
